name: csilk
description: A lightweight, high-performance HTTP web framework written in C, inspired by Gin (Golang) and built on top of libuv, llhttp, nghttp2, and yyjson. Supports HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, WebSocket, SSE, TLS, JWT auth, AI workflow, message queue, Prometheus metrics, and pluggable database drivers (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis).

full.description: Enable all optional domain modules (DB, MQ, AI, Vector, MCP, Workflow, gRPC, WASM, Perm, Observability, CSV)

db.description: Database drivers, migrations, and connection pools (SQLite3)

ai.description: LLM client drivers, AI trace, and tool registry (libcurl)

vector.description: Embedded HNSW and Milvus/Qdrant vector drivers (libcurl)

workflow.description: AI workflow DAG engine, DSL, grid, and skill sandbox (libcurl)

mq.description: Message queue, PubSub, WAL, and Raft consensus

grpc.description: gRPC wire codec and HTTP/JSON transcoding gateway

observability.description: OTLP tracing, CPU flamegraph profiler, and Admin/APM dashboard

shared.description: Build shared library in addition to static
